name: Ronin

abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Parry Non-Contact: Siper (Parry) ustalığının temassız saldırılara karşı da Stun tetiklemesini sağlar.
abilityDetails.Reduce Defensive AA: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Disorient: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu ve blok yeterliliğini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.

signatureAbility:
Unrelenting Agility
While at 7 Cruelty Passives, Ronin gains a Passive Evasion on the next incoming Attack for [0.4 - 2] seconds. Removes 3 Cruelty Passives when Ronin Evades an attack. Successful Evades do not grant Stance Abilities.
When Ronin Evades an attack, gain a Fury Passive increasing Attack Rating by [1,334.58 - 2,053.23] for 12 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: When Ronin would Miss an Attack or be Evaded he gains a Cruelty Passive increasing Critical Damage by [339.89]. Max 7 stacks.

abilitySections.title: Sword Attacks
content: Attacks using the Sword have a 15% chance to inflict Bleed dealing [3,593.1] Direct Damage over 3.5 seconds. Critical Strikes using the Sword have a 100% to inflict Bleed.
Intercepting attacks has +[1,833.33] Critical Rating.
Against Bleed Immune Champions gain a Cruelty Passive when Ronin would inflict a Bleed. This cannot occur more than once every 2.5 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Stance Preparation
content: Ronin prepares his Stances by performing light attacks. Light 1 prepares Guard Stance, Light 2 prepares Wraith Stance, and Light 3 prepares Demon Stance.
Dodging back after preparing a stance makes Ronin enter a Stance. Stances are not affected by Ability Accuracy Reduction.
When entering a new Stance, gain a Cruelty Passive increasing Critical Damage by [339.89]. Max 7 stacks.

abilitySections.title: When Entering A Stance
content: When reaching 7 Cruelty Passives, gain a Precision Passive increasing Critical Rating by [5,107.14] for 18 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Guard Stance
content: Well Timed Blocks activate the Parry Mastery, stunning opponents even if their attack is non-contact. Ronin gains +35% chance to Perfect Block.
Entering this stance has a 100% chance to Purify a Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Wraith Stance
content: All attacks reduce Defensive Ability Accuracy by 40%.

abilitySections.title: Demon Stance
content: All Bleeds gain +75% Ability Accuracy and can be inflicted on Blocked hits.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Disorients the opponent reducing Defensive Ability Accuracy by 60% and Block Proficiency by 50% for 9 seconds.
Enters a prepared Stance.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Inflicts a Bleed that deals [3,593.1] Direct Damage over 3.5 seconds for each active Cruelty Passive.
Removes all Cruelty Passives.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain a Fury Passive increasing Attack Rating by [2,669.16] for 35 seconds. Each active Cruelty Passsive increases the Attack Rating by an additional [2,669.16].
Removes all Cruelty Passives.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Unrelenting Agility
content: While at 7 Cruelty Passives, Ronin gains a Passive Evasion on the next incoming Attack for [0.4 - 2] seconds. Removes 3 Cruelty Passives when Ronin Evades an attack. Successful Evades do not grant Stance Abilities.
When Ronin Evades an attack, gain a Fury Passive increasing Attack Rating by [1,334.58 - 2,053.23] for 12 seconds.
